messages:
mara.p: Hi team — Im Mara, new infra engineer. Onboarding question: I need to run an acceptance job that (1) exports a few rows to BigQuery dataset acct_billing in project mara-sbx for local validation, (2) have CI push signed AMI metadata into SSM under /onboard/mara/amis in aws acct 444555666777, and (3) the CI will create short-lived BigQuery load jobs. Who owns these permissions and whats the minimal set I should request? cc @cloud-ops
jon: welcome Mara! :wave: For BigQuery writes and load jobs, a common pattern is: create a GCP service account in your sandbox project, grant it roles/bigquery.dataEditor on the specific dataset and roles/bigquery.jobUser at the project level (so it can run load/query jobs). Then give your user roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator on that SA so CI can impersonate it.
carmen: For GKE, use Workload Identity: make a k8s service account and bind to the GCP SA. If CI uses OIDC (GHA/GCP/other), include the OIDC issuer and subject in the ticket.
infra-bot: Reminder: please open a cloud-access ticket using the onboarding template: https://redwood.atlassian.net/secure/CreateIssue!default.jspa?project=CLOUD Select 'Onboarding - IAM/Permissions' and include GCP project id, dataset name, k8s ns & ksa, OIDC issuer/sub (if applicable), AWS account id, SSM path, and desired expiry.
sarah: For the AWS side we prefer cross-account assume-roles in the infra account so people get temporary sessions. Minimal SSM permission is ssm:PutParameter on the specific path. If you also sign AMIs, add ec2:CreateTags and ec2:DescribeImages. Share the registry/AMI signing flow in the ticket so infra can scope it tightly.
mara.p: also need to enable billing export in the project — who approves that? I dont want to ask for overly broad rights.
finance-bot: Quick FYI: linking a project to a billing account requires Billing Account User role on the billing account or a finance admin to run the export config. Typically we ask finance@redwood to toggle the billing export or we file a request in the ticket and loop in billing-admins. Please state the billing account id and desired dataset in the ticket.
jon: sample CLI snippets you can paste into the ticket if infra wants to pre-provision: ```bash
# create SA
gcloud iam service-accounts create mara-billing-sa --project=mara-sbx --display-name="mara billing writer"
# grant dataset editor
bq add-iam-policy-binding mara-sbx:acct_billing --member=serviceAccount:mara-billing-sa@mara-sbx.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/bigquery.dataEditor
# grant jobUser if CI needs to run load jobs
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding mara-sbx --member=serviceAccount:mara-billing-sa@mara-sbx.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/bigquery.jobUser
# allow you to impersonate SA
gcloud iam service-accounts add-iam-policy-binding mara-billing-sa@mara-sbx.iam.gserviceaccount.com --member=user:mara.p@redwood.com --role=roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator
```
carmen: AWS trust snippet to paste in ticket for infra to create the role: ```json
{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[{
    "Effect":"Allow",
    "Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT_ID:user/mara.p@redwood.com"},
    "Action":"sts:AssumeRole"
  }]
}
```
(infra will change Principal to a federated principal if you use OIDC).
sarah: One more gotcha: org policy blocks certain locations for storage used by billing export in some org folders. If you need dataset in a specific region, call it out. Also default onboarding expiry for dataset+SSM write is 21 days for validation tasks; if you need extended access include justification and manager approval.
mara.p: thanks — I prefer 21d expiry. Ill include project=mara-sbx, dataset=acct_billing, k8s ns=acceptance, ksa=accept-billing-ksa, aws acct=444555666777, ssm=/onboard/mara/amis, billing_acct=012345-678901-ABCDEF, expiry=21d, CI uses GHA OIDC (issuer=https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com). Filing now. Appreciate the help! :slightly_smiling_face
